faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All processing happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.question: What JSONPath syntax is supported?
faq.answer: The tester supports standard JSONPath expressions including dot notation, bracket notation, wildcards, filters, and recursive descent.

faq.question: Can I test complex JSONPath expressions?
faq.answer: Yes. You can test any valid JSONPath expression, including filters, array slices, and recursive searches.

faq.question: What is JSONPath used for?
faq.answer: JSONPath is used to extract specific values from JSON data, similar to how XPath works for XML. It is commonly used in API testing, data processing, and configuration management.

faq.question: Can I copy the results?
faq.answer: Yes. You can copy extracted values or the full results to clipboard. This is useful for using the results in your code or documentation.

faq.question: What are common JSONPath expressions?
faq.answer: Common expressions include $.key (root key), $.array[0] (first element), $.array[*] (all elements), and $..key (recursive search). The tool provides quick access to these common paths.

faq.question: Can I test JSONPath on large files?
faq.answer: Yes. Since all processing happens locally, file size is limited only by your browser's memory.

article.title: How to Test JSONPath Expressions Online
article.content:
What is JSONPath?

JSONPath is a query language for JSON, similar to XPath for XML. It allows you to navigate and extract specific values from JSON data using a simple syntax.

Common JSONPath Expressions

  • $.store.book[0].title — Get the title of the first book
  • $.store.book[*].author — Get all book authors
  • $..price — Get all prices (recursive search)
  • $.store.book[?(@.price < 10)] — Filter books under $10

How to Use the Tester

  1. Paste JSON into the input field
  2. Enter JSONPath expression (e.g., $.users[0].name)
  3. Click Evaluate to see results
  4. Copy results for use in your code

JSONPath Syntax Guide

  • $ — Root object
  • .key — Child key access
  • [n] — Array index
  • [*] — Wildcard (all elements)
  • .. — Recursive descent
  • [?(expr)] — Filter expression

Use Cases

  • API Testing: Extract values from API responses
  • Data Processing: Transform JSON data structures
  • Configuration: Navigate nested config objects
  • Debugging: Inspect specific JSON values

article.title: 如何在线测试 JSONPath 表达式
article.content:
什么是 JSONPath？

JSONPath 是 JSON 的查询语言，类似于 XML 的 XPath。它允许你使用简单的语法从 JSON 数据中导航和提取特定值。

常见 JSONPath 表达式

  • $.store.book[0].title — 获取第一本书的标题
  • $.store.book[*].author — 获取所有书籍的作者
  • $..price — 获取所有价格（递归搜索）
  • $.store.book[?(@.price < 10)] — 过滤价格低于 $10 的书

如何使用测试器

  1. 粘贴 JSON 到输入框
  2. 输入 JSONPath 表达式（如 $.users[0].name）
  3. 点击执行 查看结果
  4. 复制结果 用于代码

JSONPath 语法指南

  • $ — 根对象
  • .key — 子键访问
  • [n] — 数组索引
  • [*] — 通配符（所有元素）
  • .. — 递归下降
  • [?(expr)] — 过滤表达式

使用场景

  • API 测试：从 API 响应中提取值
  • 数据处理：转换 JSON 数据结构
  • 配置管理：导航嵌套的配置对象
  • 调试：检查特定的 JSON 值
